title: Paylocity - Unannounced layout changes and a data-scoping issue across cost centers
clean_text: Some users report that layout changes happen without advance notice and take time to figure out, alongside long wait times when calling to reach a Paylocity representative. One reported issue arose when transitioning to using departments as cost centers, which created problems with benefit provider file feeds and impacted data accuracy. Employee-side scheduling has also been reported to show colleagues from other clinics or locations across the company rather than scoping the view to just the employee's own team, a data-visibility gap for multi-site organizations.
